_authority: Income-tax Act. Rates verified against incometaxindia.gov.in and corroborated 29-07-2026.
_verify_before_use: Corporate rates change with each Finance Act. RE-VERIFY before relying on this for a filing, and update _verified_on. Never compute tax from a stale rate card.
_scope: Domestic companies only. Not applicable to LLPs, firms, or non-residents.

regimes.name: Normal rates — turnover up to ₹400 crore
regimes.condition: Total turnover or gross receipts in the prescribed base year does not exceed ₹400 crore
regimes.note: Carried-forward business losses and unabsorbed depreciation MAY be set off.

regimes.name: Concessional regime — s.115BAA
regimes.condition: Company opts in by filing Form 10-IC. The option is IRREVOCABLE.
regimes.note: CRITICAL: opting in requires forgoing specified deductions AND most carried-forward losses/unabsorbed depreciation attributable to those deductions. MAT does not apply, and any MAT CREDIT is forfeited. For a company with large carried-forward losses this can be far worse than the normal regime — model both before electing.

regimes.name: New manufacturing companies — s.115BAB
regimes.condition: Incorporated on or after 01-10-2019 and commenced manufacturing by the prescribed date
regimes.note: Not applicable to a services company.

mat.note: MAT applies where normal tax is less than 15% of book profit. Book profit is computed under Explanation 1 to s.115JB and is NOT the same as accounting profit. MAT credit may be carried forward 15 years.

common_disallowances.description: 30% of specified payments where TDS was not deducted or not deposited by the due date of filing the return
Income tax paid, charged to P&L
Penalties and fines for breach of law (not compensatory interest)
Employee PF/ESI contribution not deposited by the DUE DATE UNDER THE RELEVANT ACT — disallowed permanently (Checkmate Services, SC 2022)
Statutory dues (tax, duty, cess, PF employer contribution, bonus, leave encashment) allowed only on ACTUAL PAYMENT by the return due date
Payments to micro and small enterprises beyond the MSMED time limit — disallowed until paid
Depreciation under the Act differs from Companies Act depreciation — add back book depreciation, deduct tax depreciation on the block of assets

business_loss.note: Set off against business income only. Requires the return to have been filed within the s.139(1) due date.

unabsorbed_depreciation.note: May be carried forward indefinitely and set off against ANY head of income.

capital_loss_long_term.note: Set off against long-term capital gains only.

closely_held_company_restriction.note: A company in which the public are not substantially interested loses carried-forward losses if beneficial shareholding carrying at least 51% of voting power changes. CHECK THIS if there has been any share transfer or buyback.
